about: Every line of text in the game, by the key it has in the doc "Shave the Mammoth: Game Text" (https://claude.ai/artifact/UDhJP6iHabzjtx9QFA8vop), as it stood when the doc was filled. shown: the line as written in the doc ({braces} are filled in by the game, [E] is a key cap, **bold** is bold, (keyboard: ... / touch: ...) differs by device). file, line, raw: where it is in the source and exactly how it is written there, where it is one string. A line changed in the doc is put back by finding its key here. A key is a name, not a position: when a line is deleted, the keys after it stay as they are.

page.legend.1.shown: Legend has it, great woolly mammoths roamed the earth...

page.legend.2.shown: ...but then a legend came and shaved them, and now they are elephants...

page.skip.shown: (keyboard: Click or press any key to skip / touch: Tap to skip)

main.down.novelty.shown: **{novelty}.** {Gnorman's patter for it} Hold the cut button where it works.

says.HELLO.0.raw: Yes, hello, hi. I’ll have a full trim please.
says.HELLO.0.shown: Yes, hello, hi. I’ll have a full trim please.

says.TRIM.0.raw: Did I say full trim? I meant just a little off the sides. Too late for that I guess.
says.TRIM.0.shown: Did I say full trim? I meant just a little off the sides. Too late for that I guess.

says.HELLO_AGAIN.0.raw: Ten thousand years, and not one bad hair day.
says.HELLO_AGAIN.0.shown: Ten thousand years, and not one bad hair day.

says.AGAIN.0.raw: Oh. It’s you. And the scissors.
says.AGAIN.0.shown: Oh. It’s you. And the scissors.

says.AGAIN.1.raw: You came back. I had hoped you were a dream.
says.AGAIN.1.shown: You came back. I had hoped you were a dream.

says.AGAIN.2.raw: Still here. Still cold. Thank you for asking.
says.AGAIN.2.shown: Still here. Still cold. Thank you for asking.

says.AGAIN_BALD.1.raw: Yes, well. Here I am. All of me.
says.AGAIN_BALD.1.shown: Yes, well. Here I am. All of me.

says.WAITING.0.raw: Take a good look. It is the last time I will look like this.
says.WAITING.0.shown: Take a good look. It is the last time I will look like this.

says.WAITING.1.raw: Still here. Still woolly. For now.
says.WAITING.1.shown: Still here. Still woolly. For now.

says.FIRST_CUT.0.raw: Excuse me. Did you just... you did.
says.FIRST_CUT.0.shown: Excuse me. Did you just... you did.

says.FIRST_CUT.1.raw: Oh. We are really doing this, then.
says.FIRST_CUT.1.shown: Oh. We are really doing this, then.

says.STOPPED.0.raw: Is that it? Are we done? ...No. Of course not.
says.STOPPED.0.shown: Is that it? Are we done? ...No. Of course not.

says.DAWDLING.0.raw: Take your time. I have only got the one interglacial.
says.DAWDLING.0.shown: Take your time. I have only got the one interglacial.

says.DAWDLING.1.raw: Are we resting? I was not told we were resting.
says.DAWDLING.1.shown: Are we resting? I was not told we were resting.

says.SO_FAR.0.1.raw: Is this going to take all day?
says.SO_FAR.0.1.shown: Is this going to take all day?

says.SO_FAR.0.25.raw: It is getting draughty in here.
says.SO_FAR.0.25.shown: It is getting draughty in here.

says.SO_FAR.0.5.raw: Half an elephant. The wrong half.
says.SO_FAR.0.5.shown: Half an elephant. The wrong half.

says.SO_FAR.0.75.raw: I can see my own knees. I have knees!
says.SO_FAR.0.75.shown: I can see my own knees. I have knees!

says.SO_FAR.0.9.raw: Leave me something. One tuft. A dignity tuft.
says.SO_FAR.0.9.shown: Leave me something. One tuft. A dignity tuft.

says.BALD.0.raw: I got my wish. I am an elephant. I hate it.
says.BALD.0.shown: I got my wish. I am an elephant. I hate it.

says.SOLD.0.raw: That was my hair he just bought. Just so we are clear.
says.SOLD.0.shown: That was my hair he just bought. Just so we are clear.

says.SOLD.1.raw: Do I get a cut? Of the money. I have had the other kind.
says.SOLD.1.shown: Do I get a cut? Of the money. I have had the other kind.

says.SOLD.2.raw: A toupee. I am going to be somebody’s toupee.
says.SOLD.2.shown: A toupee. I am going to be somebody’s toupee.

says.REGROWN.0.raw: Oh, that is better. ...Why are you still holding those?
says.REGROWN.0.shown: Oh, that is better. ...Why are you still holding those?

says.REGROWN.1.raw: I’m back. Put the scissors down.
says.REGROWN.1.shown: I’m back. Put the scissors down.

says.FOUND_ANY.0.raw: Nobody was ever supposed to see that.
says.FOUND_ANY.0.shown: Nobody was ever supposed to see that.

says.FOUND_ANY.1.raw: It seemed like a good idea ten thousand years ago.
says.FOUND_ANY.1.shown: It seemed like a good idea ten thousand years ago.

says.UNDER.1.raw: Mind your head. And mine. And everything.
says.UNDER.1.shown: Mind your head. And mine. And everything.

says.BEHIND.1.raw: Nobody good ever stands back there.
says.BEHIND.1.shown: Nobody good ever stands back there.

says.THUD.0.raw: Are you all right? Don’t tell me. I don’t mind either way.
says.THUD.0.shown: Are you all right? Don’t tell me. I don’t mind either way.

says.PERCHED.0.raw: You are standing on me. We both know you are standing on me.
says.PERCHED.0.shown: You are standing on me. We both know you are standing on me.

says.EYE_LEVEL.0.raw: Oh. Hello. Eye level. I preferred you as a rumour.
says.EYE_LEVEL.0.shown: Oh. Hello. Eye level. I preferred you as a rumour.

says.FLYING.0.raw: It flies now. Wonderful. It flies.
says.FLYING.0.shown: It flies now. Wonderful. It flies.

says.BOUGHT.sheep.raw: Shears. I am not a sheep. I want that on record.
says.BOUGHT.sheep.shown: Shears. I am not a sheep. I want that on record.

says.BOUGHT.garden.raw: Garden clippers. I am not a hedge.
says.BOUGHT.garden.shown: Garden clippers. I am not a hedge.

says.BOUGHT.shaver.raw: It hums. I don’t like that it hums.
says.BOUGHT.shaver.shown: It hums. I don’t like that it hums.

says.BOUGHT.electric.raw: Electric? Nobody said anything about electric.
says.BOUGHT.electric.shown: Electric? Nobody said anything about electric.

says.BOUGHT.twig.raw: You are sweeping me up. While I watch.
says.BOUGHT.twig.shown: You are sweeping me up. While I watch.

says.BOUGHT.push.raw: A bigger broom. For more of me.
says.BOUGHT.push.shown: A bigger broom. For more of me.

says.BOUGHT.handvac.raw: Must you hoover while I am standing here?
says.BOUGHT.handvac.shown: Must you hoover while I am standing here?

says.BOUGHT.shopvac.raw: Point that somewhere else. Anywhere else.
says.BOUGHT.shopvac.shown: Point that somewhere else. Anywhere else.

says.BOUGHT.crate.raw: A milk crate. I am being shaved from a milk crate.
says.BOUGHT.crate.shown: A milk crate. I am being shaved from a milk crate.

says.BOUGHT.step.raw: Oh, good. Now you can reach my knees.
says.BOUGHT.step.shown: Oh, good. Now you can reach my knees.

says.BOUGHT.painter.raw: That ladder has paint on it. I hope it is paint.
says.BOUGHT.painter.shown: That ladder has paint on it. I hope it is paint.

says.BOUGHT.fire.raw: Is something on fire? Is it me?
says.BOUGHT.fire.shown: Is something on fire? Is it me?

says.BOUGHT.soda.raw: Is that fizzy pop? Strapped to an elf?
says.BOUGHT.soda.shown: Is that fizzy pop? Strapped to an elf?

says.BOUGHT.blower.raw: It is very loud. I have enormous ears, you know.
says.BOUGHT.blower.shown: It is very loud. I have enormous ears, you know.

says.BOUGHT.jet.raw: Elves were never meant to fly. Nor mammoths, but nobody tried.
says.BOUGHT.jet.shown: Elves were never meant to fly. Nor mammoths, but nobody tried.

says.BOUGHT.feather.raw: Is that a feather? Keep it away from my legs.
says.BOUGHT.feather.shown: Is that a feather? Keep it away from my legs.

says.BOUGHT.nosespray.raw: I can smell menthol. I do not like where this is going.
says.BOUGHT.nosespray.shown: I can smell menthol. I do not like where this is going.

says.BOUGHT.scratcher.raw: What is the little hand for?
says.BOUGHT.scratcher.shown: What is the little hand for?

says.BOUGHT.varnish.raw: Red? For me? I could not possibly. What kind of red?
says.BOUGHT.varnish.shown: Red? For me? I could not possibly. What kind of red?

says.BOUGHT.tarot.raw: Cards. I do not hold with cards.
says.BOUGHT.tarot.shown: Cards. I do not hold with cards.

says.BOUGHT.plunger.raw: That had better be for the snow.
says.BOUGHT.plunger.shown: That had better be for the snow.

says.BOUGHT.polish.raw: Lambswool. Nobody ever asks the lamb.
says.BOUGHT.polish.shown: Lambswool. Nobody ever asks the lamb.

says.BOUGHT.watch.raw: A watch. You will find that I am not suggestible.
says.BOUGHT.watch.shown: A watch. You will find that I am not suggestible.

says.BOUGHT.depil.raw: Mammoth strength? Who tried it? On WHOM?
says.BOUGHT.depil.shown: Mammoth strength? Who tried it? On WHOM?

says.BOUGHT.lemming.raw: Something is climbing my leg. It has very cold feet.
says.BOUGHT.lemming.shown: Something is climbing my leg. It has very cold feet.

says.BOUGHT.lemmings.raw: There are more of them. They appear to be organised.
says.BOUGHT.lemmings.shown: There are more of them. They appear to be organised.

says.BOUGHT.tank.raw: More fuel. More of you, up here, with me.
says.BOUGHT.tank.shown: More fuel. More of you, up here, with me.

says.BOUGHT.loyal.raw: A loyalty card. For shaving me. I see.
says.BOUGHT.loyal.shown: A loyalty card. For shaving me. I see.

says.BOUGHT.cocoa.raw: Is that cocoa? None for me. No. Fine.
says.BOUGHT.cocoa.shown: Is that cocoa? None for me. No. Fine.

says.BOUGHT.box.0.raw: Was I in it? Then I don’t care.
says.BOUGHT.box.0.shown: Was I in it? Then I don’t care.

says.BOUGHT.box.1.raw: Was it a hat? I would have liked a hat.
says.BOUGHT.box.1.shown: Was it a hat? I would have liked a hat.

says.BOUGHT.partyhat.raw: Is it my birthday? Nobody came to the last four thousand.
says.BOUGHT.partyhat.shown: Is it my birthday? Nobody came to the last four thousand.

says.BOUGHT.shades.raw: I can’t see what you are doing now. Perfect.
says.BOUGHT.shades.shown: I can’t see what you are doing now. Perfect.

says.BOUGHT.pinkdye.raw: Why is the vulture laughing? ...Am I pink?
says.BOUGHT.pinkdye.shown: Why is the vulture laughing? ...Am I pink?

says.IDLE.0.raw: Is this going to take all day?
says.IDLE.0.shown: Is this going to take all day?

says.IDLE.1.raw: I wish I was an elephant. I could save so much on haircuts.
says.IDLE.1.shown: I wish I was an elephant. I could save so much on haircuts.

says.IDLE.2.raw: You missed a bit. I am not saying where.
says.IDLE.2.shown: You missed a bit. I am not saying where.

says.IDLE.3.raw: Could you at least warm the blades?
says.IDLE.3.shown: Could you at least warm the blades?

says.IDLE.4.raw: I had plans today. Standing here, mostly. But still.
says.IDLE.4.shown: I had plans today. Standing here, mostly. But still.

says.IDLE.5.raw: Do you do this to everyone, or am I special?
says.IDLE.5.shown: Do you do this to everyone, or am I special?

says.IDLE.6.raw: My mother warned me about elves.
says.IDLE.6.shown: My mother warned me about elves.

says.IDLE.7.raw: A little off the top, I said. A LITTLE.
says.IDLE.7.shown: A little off the top, I said. A LITTLE.

says.IDLE.8.raw: That tickles. Stop it. No, carry on. No, stop.
says.IDLE.8.shown: That tickles. Stop it. No, carry on. No, stop.

says.IDLE.9.raw: Ten thousand years I spent growing that.
says.IDLE.9.shown: Ten thousand years I spent growing that.

says.IDLE.10.raw: There is a draught where there has never been a draught.
says.IDLE.10.shown: There is a draught where there has never been a draught.

says.IDLE.11.raw: Is it cold, or is it you?
says.IDLE.11.shown: Is it cold, or is it you?

says.IDLE.12.raw: Tell me when it is over. Or don’t.
says.IDLE.12.shown: Tell me when it is over. Or don’t.

says.IDLE_WHEN.0.raw: Small scissors. Big mammoth. I admire the optimism.
says.IDLE_WHEN.0.shown: Small scissors. Big mammoth. I admire the optimism.

says.IDLE_WHEN.2.raw: That is me you are sweeping up, you know.
says.IDLE_WHEN.2.shown: That is me you are sweeping up, you know.

says.IDLE_WHEN.4.raw: Do I look pink to you? I feel pink.
says.IDLE_WHEN.4.shown: Do I look pink to you? I feel pink.

says.IDLE_WHEN.5.raw: Is the hat still on? I can feel a hat.
says.IDLE_WHEN.5.shown: Is the hat still on? I can feel a hat.

says.IDLE_WHEN.6.raw: I look magnificent. Nobody tell me otherwise.
says.IDLE_WHEN.6.shown: I look magnificent. Nobody tell me otherwise.

says.IDLE_WHEN.8.raw: At this rate I shall be extinct first.
says.IDLE_WHEN.8.shown: At this rate I shall be extinct first.

says.IDLE_WHEN.9.raw: Nobody has called me Kevin in nine thousand years.
says.IDLE_WHEN.9.shown: Nobody has called me Kevin in nine thousand years.

says.IDLE_WHEN.10.raw: I was young. It was the Pleistocene.
says.IDLE_WHEN.10.shown: I was young. It was the Pleistocene.

says.IDLE_WHEN.12.raw: In my day a mammoth kept his hide to himself.
says.IDLE_WHEN.12.shown: In my day a mammoth kept his hide to himself.

says.IDLE_WHEN.13.raw: Nice boys, the cave men. Dreadful manners. Lovely apologies.
says.IDLE_WHEN.13.shown: Nice boys, the cave men. Dreadful manners. Lovely apologies.

says.IDLE_WHEN.14.raw: I have paid out more this week than in the last ten thousand years.
says.IDLE_WHEN.14.shown: I have paid out more this week than in the last ten thousand years.

says.IDLE_WHEN.15.raw: They tickle. All of them. All the time.
says.IDLE_WHEN.15.shown: They tickle. All of them. All the time.

says.IDLE_WHEN.16.raw: One of them is in my ear. Hello? Yes. Out.
says.IDLE_WHEN.16.shown: One of them is in my ear. Hello? Yes. Out.

says.IDLE_WHEN.17.raw: I have more lemmings than hair. This was not the plan.
says.IDLE_WHEN.17.shown: I have more lemmings than hair. This was not the plan.

game.SAYS.gnome.hello.0.raw: Welcome, welcome! Biggest fan. BIGGEST. Have you seen him? Magnificent. Now take it all off.
game.SAYS.gnome.hello.0.shown: Welcome, welcome! Biggest fan. BIGGEST. Have you seen him? Magnificent. Now take it all off.

game.SAYS.gnome.hello.1.raw: I have followed that mammoth for nine years. He has never once looked at me. Buy something.
game.SAYS.gnome.hello.1.shown: I have followed that mammoth for nine years. He has never once looked at me. Buy something.

game.SAYS.gnome.hello.2.raw: Back again! He was asking after you. Well, he broke wind in your direction. Same thing.
game.SAYS.gnome.hello.2.shown: Back again! He was asking after you. Well, he broke wind in your direction. Same thing.

game.SAYS.gnome.hello.3.raw: Everything is sharp, everything is final, and everything was his idea, if anyone asks.
game.SAYS.gnome.hello.3.shown: Everything is sharp, everything is final, and everything was his idea, if anyone asks.

game.gnome.note.0.raw: PINK! You made him PINK. I have never loved him more.
game.gnome.note.0.shown: PINK! You made him PINK. I have never loved him more.

game.gnome.note.1.raw: You have seen the thong, then. We do not speak of the thong.
game.gnome.note.1.shown: You have seen the thong, then. We do not speak of the thong.

game.gnome.note.2.raw: He looks so happy in the hat. You cannot tell, but I can. Nine years.
game.gnome.note.2.shown: He looks so happy in the hat. You cannot tell, but I can. Nine years.

game.gnome.note.3.raw: There is hardly any of him left to be a fan of. I shall be a fan of what there is.
game.gnome.note.3.shown: There is hardly any of him left to be a fan of. I shall be a fan of what there is.

game.gnome.note.4.raw: He is half the mammoth he was. I have had to let out my scrapbook.
game.gnome.note.4.shown: He is half the mammoth he was. I have had to let out my scrapbook.

game.gnome.note.5.raw: The tattoos! I knew about four. I was present for one.
game.gnome.note.5.shown: The tattoos! I knew about four. I was present for one.

game.gnome.note.6.raw: They said sorry to him? I brought those boys up myself. No refunds.
game.gnome.note.6.shown: They said sorry to him? I brought those boys up myself. No refunds.

game.gnome.note.7.raw: Gold out of his ears. Nine years I have followed him, and it never once occurred to me to ask.
game.gnome.note.7.shown: Gold out of his ears. Nine years I have followed him, and it never once occurred to me to ask.

game.SAYS.gnome.poor.0.raw: That is not enough gold. That is barely any gold. Go and cut something off him.
game.SAYS.gnome.poor.0.shown: That is not enough gold. That is barely any gold. Go and cut something off him.

game.SAYS.gnome.poor.1.raw: I do not do credit. I did credit once. I keep his kneecaps in a jar.
game.SAYS.gnome.poor.1.shown: I do not do credit. I did credit once. I keep his kneecaps in a jar.

game.SAYS.gnome.poor.2.raw: You cannot afford that. You can afford to look at it. Looking is free until Thursday.
game.SAYS.gnome.poor.2.shown: You cannot afford that. You can afford to look at it. Looking is free until Thursday.

game.SAYS.gnome.sold.0.raw: A fine choice. Do not come crying to me. Come buying to me.
game.SAYS.gnome.sold.0.shown: A fine choice. Do not come crying to me. Come buying to me.

game.SAYS.gnome.sold.1.raw: Sold! He will hate that. I shall watch from here, with a sandwich.
game.SAYS.gnome.sold.1.shown: Sold! He will hate that. I shall watch from here, with a sandwich.

game.SAYS.gnome.sold.2.raw: Pleasure doing business. I use the word pleasure loosely, as in most things.
game.SAYS.gnome.sold.2.shown: Pleasure doing business. I use the word pleasure loosely, as in most things.

game.gnome.best.raw: You have the best there is. I checked. I looked everywhere.
game.gnome.best.shown: You have the best there is. I checked. I looked everywhere.

game.box.0.raw: A sock. One. Left foot. Enjoy.
game.box.0.shown: A sock. One. Left foot. Enjoy.

game.box.1.raw: It is empty. No, wait. No, it is empty.
game.box.1.shown: It is empty. No, wait. No, it is empty.

game.box.2.raw: A drawing of what you could have won. I did it myself.
game.box.2.shown: A drawing of what you could have won. I did it myself.

game.box.3.raw: A smaller mystery box! ...With nothing in it. That is the mystery.
game.box.3.shown: A smaller mystery box! ...With nothing in it. That is the mystery.

game.box.4.raw: ${g} gold! Somebody’s purse. Finders keepers. Do not look at the initials.
game.box.4.shown: {gold} gold! Somebody’s purse. Finders keepers. Do not look at the initials.

game.box.5.raw: Hair! ${Math.round(got)} grams of it. Not his. Do not ask whose.
game.box.5.shown: Hair! {grams} grams of it. Not his. Do not ask whose.

game.box.7.raw: TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTY GOLD. I did not know that was in there. I want it noted that I did not know.
game.box.7.shown: TWO HUNDRED AND FIFTY GOLD. I did not know that was in there. I want it noted that I did not know.

catalog.section.sweeper.note.shown: It does not sell itself from the snow.

catalog.section.ladder.note.shown: He is taller than he looks, and he looks tall.

catalog.section.pack.note.shown: No refunds. No next of kin, either, by the look of you.

catalog.section.help.note.shown: They work for crumbs. The crumbs are extra.

catalog.section.gag.note.shown: Each works once, on him. What he does about it is between the two of you.

game.gnome.helpers.shown: You have {number} lemming(s) on him now.

catalog.scissors.blurb.shown: Yours already. I would not take them back.

catalog.scissors.got.shown: They are small. They are bad. They are all you have.

catalog.sheep.blurb.shown: Sprung steel. Three thousand years on sheep and not one thank-you note.

catalog.sheep.got.shown: Sprung steel! Somewhere, a sheep shudders and does not know why.

catalog.garden.blurb.shown: For hedges. A mammoth is a hedge with opinions.

catalog.garden.got.shown: They are bigger than you are. This will be fine.

catalog.shaver.blurb.shown: Takes him down to the skin, where the reading matter is. One careful owner. He is no longer with us.

catalog.shaver.got.shown: It hums. It tickles. It takes him down to the skin, and whatever is written there.

catalog.electric.blurb.shown: A strip as wide as your head with every pass. Batteries included; his consent is not.

catalog.electric.got.shown: The power of a small kitchen appliance is yours.

catalog.hands.blurb.shown: You came with these. A pinch at a time.

catalog.twig.blurb.shown: A stick with ambitions. Sweeps a patch the size of a dinner plate.

catalog.push.blurb.shown: Half a metre of bristle. The widow who sold it to me said he died doing what he loved: sweeping.

catalog.handvac.blurb.shown: It sucks, and that is the nicest thing anyone has said about it. Hold it down and wave it about.

catalog.shopvac.blurb.shown: Lifts hair from two paces. Do not point it at anything you are fond of.

catalog.crate.blurb.shown: Stand on it. That is the whole product.

catalog.step.blurb.shown: Gets you to his knees, where the conversation is better.

catalog.painter.blurb.shown: Reaches the belly. Spattered with paint and, I am told, the painter.

catalog.fire.blurb.shown: All the way to the top of his head. Fell off the back of a fire. Engine. Off the back of a fire engine.

catalog.soda.blurb.shown: Two bottles and a belt. Shake well. Lands you on your arse about half the time, which is the fun half.

catalog.blower.blurb.shown: Two leaf blowers and a rucksack. Loud enough to make him flinch. Six seconds up, then physics.

catalog.jet.blurb.shown: A proper one. Hovers. The Mk I is why I have this hat and not the other hat.

catalog.lemming.blurb.shown: Climbs. Gnaws. Finds the bits you missed. Has no idea what a mammoth is and is not going to be told.

catalog.lemmings.blurb.shown: They work better in company. They do everything better in company. That is the trouble with lemmings.

catalog.plague.blurb.shown: Thirty. I counted twice and got thirty once. He will be bald by supper and you will not have lifted a finger.

catalog.cavemen.blurb.shown: Four of them, with spears. Professional hunters. They will have him down and skinned by teatime. No refunds.

catalog.feather.blurb.shown: From a bird that will not be needing it. He is ticklish about the legs. Everybody is ticklish somewhere.

catalog.feather.use.shown: Tickle one of his legs with it.

catalog.nosespray.blurb.shown: One squirt clears a nose two metres long. Stand to one side. I cannot stress the side enough.

catalog.nosespray.use.shown: Squirt it up the end of his trunk.

catalog.scratcher.blurb.shown: A little wooden hand on a very long stick. He cannot reach his own belly. Ten thousand years of itch.

catalog.scratcher.use.shown: Stand under him, look up, and scratch his belly.

catalog.varnish.blurb.shown: One coat, eighteen nails. He has never once seen his own feet. Tell him they look lovely.

catalog.varnish.use.shown: Paint the toenails of any of his feet.

catalog.tarot.blurb.shown: A full deck, bar the ones I lost. Read him his future. Do not tell him how you know.

catalog.tarot.use.shown: Stand in front of him, where he can see you, and deal.

catalog.plunger.blurb.shown: For blockages. It is the longest nose in the world and nobody has ever looked up it.

catalog.plunger.use.shown: Put it on the end of his trunk and pump.

catalog.needles.blurb.shown: Five. Ancient eastern medicine, from a man to the east of here. Stick them in anywhere; that is how it works.

catalog.needles.use.shown: Throw all five into him. Anywhere will do.

catalog.polish.blurb.shown: A ball of lambswool on a stick, and a tin of something. Brings ivory up like a new tooth.

catalog.polish.use.shown: Buff one of his tusks with it.

catalog.watch.blurb.shown: Swing it before his eyes and suggest something. I take no responsibility for what you suggest.

catalog.watch.use.shown: Stand in front of him and swing it where he can see.

catalog.depil.blurb.shown: One can. Whatever it touches falls out in handfuls. Do not get it on your eyebrows. I did.

catalog.depil.use.shown: Spray it on his coat and keep it moving. What falls off is yours to pick up.

catalog.suck.blurb.shown: For either vacuum. I bore the pipe out with a spoon.

catalog.suck.level2.blurb.shown: Two thirds more reach. Hold on to your eyebrows.

catalog.tank.blurb.shown: For any pack. More of whatever is in there.

catalog.tank.level1.blurb.shown: Half as long again in the air.

catalog.tank.level2.blurb.shown: Twice as long in the air. Twice the crater.

catalog.tonic.blurb.shown: Pour it on him and it all grows back by morning. It is morning. He will be furious, and fluffy.

catalog.loyal.blurb.shown: A tenth off everything, for ever. Every tenth stamp I judge you silently.

catalog.foot.blurb.shown: Mortimer pays 15% more when you carry it. Not lucky for the rabbit, but then what is.

catalog.cocoa.blurb.shown: You walk a quarter faster. Mostly sugar. Partly something I found.

catalog.box.blurb.shown: Could be anything. Has been, mostly, a sock.

catalog.partyhat.blurb.shown: He has not been to a party since the Pleistocene. Nobody came to that one either.

catalog.shades.blurb.shown: So that he does not have to watch what you are doing to him.

catalog.pinkdye.blurb.shown: Does one mammoth, all over, until the tonic grows it out. Mortimer pays a fifth more for pink. Nobody has asked him why.

game.tell.pink.shown: **He is pink.** All of him. He has not looked yet.

game.regrow.shown: **It all grew back.** He is furious, and fluffy.

game.swap.ladder.shown: **{ladder}.** [R] stands it up and climbs; [F] comes down.

game.SAYS.vulture.hello.0.raw: Ah. A customer. And alive. How... novel.
game.SAYS.vulture.hello.0.shown: Ah. A customer. And alive. How... novel.

game.SAYS.vulture.hello.1.raw: Mortimer. Toupees for the bald, the balding, and the recently departed. You have hair?
game.SAYS.vulture.hello.1.shown: Mortimer. Toupees for the bald, the balding, and the recently departed. You have hair?

game.SAYS.vulture.hello.2.raw: I usually wait for them to stop moving. You are saving me weeks.
game.SAYS.vulture.hello.2.shown: I usually wait for them to stop moving. You are saving me weeks.

game.SAYS.vulture.hello.3.raw: Do not mind the skull. He haggled.
game.SAYS.vulture.hello.3.shown: Do not mind the skull. He haggled.

game.SAYS.vulture.empty.0.raw: Your pockets are empty. Like the eyes of my last client.
game.SAYS.vulture.empty.0.shown: Your pockets are empty. Like the eyes of my last client.

game.SAYS.vulture.empty.1.raw: Bring me hair. On the hoof, off the hoof, I am not particular.
game.SAYS.vulture.empty.1.shown: Bring me hair. On the hoof, off the hoof, I am not particular.

game.SAYS.vulture.empty.2.raw: Nothing? I have waited at bedsides with better prospects.
game.SAYS.vulture.empty.2.shown: Nothing? I have waited at bedsides with better prospects.

game.vulture.note.0.raw: Pink. How... commercial. I will take all of it.
game.vulture.note.0.shown: Pink. How... commercial. I will take all of it.

game.vulture.note.1.raw: He is looking thin on top. And on the sides. I could do something for him. At a price.
game.vulture.note.1.shown: He is looking thin on top. And on the sides. I could do something for him. At a price.

game.vulture.note.2.raw: Sunglasses. On a mammoth. I have buried men for less.
game.vulture.note.2.shown: Sunglasses. On a mammoth. I have buried men for less.

game.SAYS.vulture.sold.0.raw: Exquisite. Greasy. Faintly warm. I shall make it into something a widow will regret.
game.SAYS.vulture.sold.0.shown: Exquisite. Greasy. Faintly warm. I shall make it into something a widow will regret.

game.SAYS.vulture.sold.1.raw: Ginger. They always want ginger. Nobody knows why, and those who did are dead.
game.SAYS.vulture.sold.1.shown: Ginger. They always want ginger. Nobody knows why, and those who did are dead.

game.SAYS.vulture.sold.2.raw: A pleasure. Do come back. Or do not. I get paid either way, eventually.
game.SAYS.vulture.sold.2.shown: A pleasure. Do come back. Or do not. I get paid either way, eventually.

game.vulture.trade.shown: Fine toupees. Hair bought by the gram.

game.vulture.weigh.shown: in your pockets, at {price} gold the hundred grams

game.vulture.lying.shown: There is another {weight} lying about on the snow. He can see it from here. He is counting.

gags.PLACES.belly.need.shown: His belly: stand under him and look up

gags.PLACES.front.need.shown: Stand in front of him, where he can see you

gags.PLACES.coat.need.shown: Any part of him with hair on it

gags.depil.go.shown: Hold to spray: keep it moving

gags.feather.during.2.raw: STOP. Hee hee hee. I mean it.
gags.feather.during.2.shown: STOP. Hee hee hee. I mean it.

gags.feather.after.0.raw: HEE HEE HEE! Stop! Things are falling out of me!
gags.feather.after.0.shown: HEE HEE HEE! Stop! Things are falling out of me!

gags.feather.tell.raw: Loose change, shaken out of his coat. It is lying all round him: walk over it.
gags.feather.tell.shown: **Loose change,** shaken out of his coat. It is lying all round him: walk over it.

gags.nosespray.tell.raw: He sneezed money. It went a long way. It is in front of him, on the snow.
gags.nosespray.tell.shown: **He sneezed money.** It went a long way. It is in front of him, on the snow.

gags.scratcher.during.1.raw: Left a bit. Left a bit.
gags.scratcher.during.1.shown: Left a bit. Left a bit.

gags.scratcher.after.0.raw: Ohhh. Ten thousand years I have had that itch.
gags.scratcher.after.0.shown: Ohhh. Ten thousand years I have had that itch.

gags.scratcher.after.1.raw: I do beg your pardon. ...Was that money?
gags.scratcher.after.1.shown: I do beg your pardon. ...Was that money?

gags.scratcher.tell.raw: Gold has come out of his bottom. It is behind him. Nobody is going to judge you.
gags.scratcher.tell.shown: **Gold has come out of his bottom.** It is behind him. Nobody is going to judge you.

gags.varnish.during.0.raw: That is cold. What is it?
gags.varnish.during.0.shown: That is cold. What is it?

gags.varnish.during.1.raw: Is it red? Tell me it is red.
gags.varnish.during.1.shown: Is it red? Tell me it is red.

gags.varnish.after.0.raw: Harlot Red! I feel twenty thousand again.
gags.varnish.after.0.shown: Harlot Red! I feel twenty thousand again.

gags.varnish.tell.raw: He blew you a kiss. There was money in it. It is on the snow in front of him.
gags.varnish.tell.shown: **He blew you a kiss.** There was money in it. It is on the snow in front of him.

gags.tarot.during.0.raw: The Fool. Small, with scissors. I see.
gags.tarot.during.0.shown: The Fool. Small, with scissors. I see.

gags.tarot.during.1.raw: The Tower. Something tall, brought low.
gags.tarot.during.1.shown: The Tower. Something tall, brought low.

gags.tarot.during.2.raw: The Elephant. That is not a real card.
gags.tarot.during.2.shown: The Elephant. That is not a real card.

gags.tarot.after.0.raw: ...It is a real card, isn’t it.
gags.tarot.after.0.shown: ...It is a real card, isn’t it.

gags.tarot.tell.raw: He wept. It was gold. It is under his chin. That is how he has always paid for things.
gags.tarot.tell.shown: **He wept.** It was gold. It is under his chin. That is how he has always paid for things.

gags.plunger.after.0.raw: POP. My ears! I can hear the sea. I can hear Norway.
gags.plunger.after.0.shown: POP. My ears! I can hear the sea. I can hear Norway.

gags.plunger.tell.raw: It came out of his ears. Both of them. Either side of his head, on the snow.
gags.plunger.tell.shown: **It came out of his ears.** Both of them. Either side of his head, on the snow.

gags.needles.each.2.raw: Is this medicine? It does not feel like medicine.
gags.needles.each.2.shown: Is this medicine? It does not feel like medicine.

gags.needles.after.0.raw: My back! Ten thousand years of it. GONE.
gags.needles.after.0.shown: My back! Ten thousand years of it. GONE.

gags.needles.after.1.raw: And that will be the blowhole. I did not know I had one.
gags.needles.after.1.shown: And that will be the blowhole. I did not know I had one.

gags.needles.tell.raw: Gold came out of the top of his head. It has rolled off him on every side.
gags.needles.tell.shown: **Gold came out of the top of his head.** It has rolled off him on every side.

gags.polish.during.1.raw: Ooh, that is coming up nicely.
gags.polish.during.1.shown: Ooh, that is coming up nicely.

gags.polish.after.0.raw: Look at that. You could eat your dinner off that.
gags.polish.after.0.shown: Look at that. You could eat your dinner off that.

gags.polish.after.1.raw: Jackpot. They have never done that before.
gags.polish.after.1.shown: Jackpot. They have never done that before.

gags.polish.tell.raw: His tusk paid out. In front of him, between the two of them.
gags.polish.tell.shown: **His tusk paid out.** In front of him, between the two of them.

gags.watch.during.1.raw: I am getting... a bit sleepy.
gags.watch.during.1.shown: I am getting... a bit sleepy.

gags.watch.after.1.raw: What? Why is everybody looking at me? Whose egg is that?
gags.watch.after.1.shown: What? Why is everybody looking at me? Whose egg is that?

gags.watch.tell.raw: He has laid an egg. A gold one. It is behind him and it is yours.
gags.watch.tell.shown: **He has laid an egg.** A gold one. It is behind him and it is yours.

gags.depil.lines.1.raw: It tingles a great deal. Is it meant to?
gags.depil.lines.1.shown: It tingles a great deal. Is it meant to?

gags.depil.after.0.raw: I can feel a draught. A very particular draught.
gags.depil.after.0.shown: I can feel a draught. A very particular draught.

gags.depil.tell.raw: The can is empty, and so is that part of him. What fell off is yours to pick up.
gags.depil.tell.shown: **The can is empty,** and so is that part of him. What fell off is yours to pick up.

raid.visit2.him.raw: You again. We have talked about this.
raid.visit2.him.shown: You again. We have talked about this.

raid.visit2.men.1.raw: It’s the elf. He keeps paying us.
raid.visit2.men.1.shown: It’s the elf. He keeps paying us.

raid.visit2.bye.raw: Lovely to see you. Off you go.
raid.visit2.bye.shown: Lovely to see you. Off you go.

raid.visit3.men.2.raw: It’s more of a gesture, really.
raid.visit3.men.2.shown: It’s more of a gesture, really.

raid.visit3.bye.raw: That is very kind. Go home.
raid.visit3.bye.shown: That is very kind. Go home.

raid.coming.raw: Cave men. They are on their way. You will hear them before you see them.
raid.coming.shown: **Cave men.** They are on their way. You will hear them before you see them.

raid.gone.raw: The cave men have gone home. They said sorry. Gnorman does not give refunds.
raid.gone.shown: **The cave men have gone home.** They said sorry. Gnorman does not give refunds.

tattoo.left.remark: It is on his right leg.
tattoo.left.says: Yes. I know which leg that is.

tattoo.otherleft.remark: It is on his left leg. He had it done second.
tattoo.otherleft.says: They put it right. In a sense.

tattoo.bestbefore.raw: BEST BEFORE: END OF ICE AGE
tattoo.bestbefore.shown: BEST BEFORE: END OF ICE AGE
tattoo.bestbefore.lettering: BEST BEFORE: / END OF ICE AGE (under a bar code)
tattoo.bestbefore.remark: He is some way past it.

tattoo.thaw.raw: IF FOUND FROZEN, DO NOT THAW
tattoo.thaw.shown: IF FOUND FROZEN, DO NOT THAW
tattoo.thaw.lettering: IF FOUND FROZEN / DO NOT THAW
tattoo.thaw.says: I mean it. I have seen what happens.

tattoo.cuthere.lettering: CUT HERE (on a dotted line, with a small pair of scissors)
tattoo.cuthere.says: That was a joke. That was a JOKE.

tattoo.butcher.lettering: RUMP · LOIN · RIBS · CHUCK · BELLY · MORE BELLY · the good bit · serves 400 (a butcher’s chart of him)
tattoo.butcher.remark: He lost a bet, or won one. Hard to say.
tattoo.butcher.says: I am told the brisket is very good.

tattoo.livelaugh.remark: Two out of three so far.
tattoo.livelaugh.says: My sister has the same one. Had.

tattoo.mum.lettering: MUM / d. 9,994 BC (a heart with an arrow through it)
tattoo.mum.says: She would have liked you. Briefly.

tattoo.death.lettering: DEATH BEFORE SHAVING (a skull over crossed razors)
tattoo.death.says: Yes. Well. Here we both are.

tattoo.honk.remark: He has not got a horn. He has got a trunk. It is worse.
tattoo.honk.says: I was going through a phase. An interglacial.

tattoo.ride.raw: MY OTHER RIDE IS YOUR MUM
tattoo.ride.shown: MY OTHER RIDE IS YOUR MUM
tattoo.ride.lettering: MY OTHER RIDE / IS YOUR MUM
tattoo.ride.says: I don’t know what it means either.

tattoo.nosy.remark: You are lying on your back under a mammoth with a pair of scissors. Yes.

tattoo.dnr.lettering: D.N.R. / do not resuscitate / (seriously. it is far too warm now)
tattoo.dnr.says: I have thought about it a great deal.

tattoo.hello.lettering: HELLO / my name is / Kevin (a name badge)
tattoo.hello.says: Kevin. Yes. Go on, get it out of your system.

tattoo.property.lettering: PROPERTY OF / Gnorman, the last elf, that glacier, Tina (each crossed out) / NOBODY
tattoo.property.remark: It has been a long ten thousand years.
tattoo.property.says: We do not talk about her.

tattoo.tooclose.raw: IF YOU CAN READ THIS YOU ARE TOO CLOSE
tattoo.tooclose.shown: IF YOU CAN READ THIS YOU ARE TOO CLOSE
tattoo.tooclose.lettering: IF YOU CAN READ THIS / YOU ARE TOO CLOSE
tattoo.tooclose.remark: You are. You have been for some time.

tattoo.tusks.lettering: I ♥ BIG TUSKS / (and I cannot lie)
tattoo.tusks.remark: He has two. He is very proud.

finds.tattoo.last.shown: That is all of them. You know him better than his mother did.

finds.thong.shown: **He is wearing a thong.** Pink. Of course he is. Gnorman pays {gold} gold to have that confirmed.
